title: Account Executive, Fintech
description: <h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2> <p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.</p> <p>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of<a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny"> Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>,<a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&sh=55c076453c61"> Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>,<a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022"> Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.</p> <p>Check out our investors and read more about us<a href="https://www.alloy.com/about"> here</a>.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite twice a week, and remote employees onsite once a quarter.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>Alloy expanded its operations globally in 2022 and has gained significant momentum in addressing fraud, risk, and compliance challenges for leading clients such as Monzo, WorldPay, and Santander. Our international focus is a key aspect of our mission to make the financial services industry more dynamic and accessible. To support this global strategy, we are enhancing our UK team based in London to serve the wider UK and EMEA regions better. </p> <p>We’re delighted to be hiring, and our newest team member will be tasked with growing our business within our Strategic global accounts.</p> <p>The objectives will be to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Target Growth in Fintech and Banking: </strong>Driving booking growth and market penetration, specifically in the fintech and banking sectors by achieving ambitious sales targets and securing large-scale enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Build Relationships with senior executives and technology partners: </strong>Develop strong, long-lasting relationships with senior executives and key partners to understand their specific challenges and position Alloy as a strategic, high-value solution.</li> <li><strong>Position Alloy as an Industry Leader: </strong>Create and implement strategies to establish our enterprise platform as the top solution for compliance and risk management.</li> <li><strong>Identify and Engage High-Potential Companies: </strong>Identify high-potential companies and key stakeholder mapping to implement effective prospecting strategies to capture their interest in Alloy.</li> <li><strong>Communicate Strategically and Effectively: </strong>Think strategically and demonstrate excellent interpersonal, communication, and writing skills to simplify complex contractual, technical, and financial details.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2> <p>Reporting to the Director of UK/EMEA, Alloy is looking for an eager-to-learn, resourceful and results-focused player, preferably with 4+ years of quota-carrying SaaS platform sales. We require an entrepreneurial and driven account executive who can balance scrappiness with strategic thinking, take the lessons we have in the US, and translate them into the correct positioning and sales process for engaging and closing new clients in the UK & EMEA. Someone who will standout carries the following experience: </p> <ul> <li>Strong communication skills, with a focus on client-specific needs</li> <li>Ability to craft a compelling and differentiated value proposition</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional hybrid environment</li> <li>Ability to identify and prioritise high-value targets</li> <li>Effectiveness in building relationships with senior executives</li> <li>Clear, logical, and actionable sales strategy</li> <li>Demonstrated understanding of account management strategies</li> <li>Ability to build long-term, trusted relationships with key clients</li> <li>Have excellent sales methodology acumen and can confidently demonstrate a professional approach to sales—preferably MEDDPICC. </li> <li>Demonstrated success in prospecting and consultative sales with strong discovery skills, empathy, and the ability to close business.</li> <li>Highly collaborative, efficiently coordinating with external partners and internal resources.</li> <li>Has a strong and growing social brand </li> <li>Self-motivated, analytical, and ambitious with an entrepreneurial spirit.</li> <li>Ability to travel within EU/EMEA as well as to America for team events and training</li> </ul> <p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p> <p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p> <h2>Benefits and Perks </h2> <ul> <li>Unlimited holiday and flexible work policy</li> <li>Pension with employee contribution</li> <li>Up to 100% compensation for 16 weeks of parental leave</li> <li>Home office stipend for new employees</li> <li>Annual £900 learning & development stipend</li> <li>Equity plan </li> <li>Uncapped commissions </li> <li>Training programs to help foster growth (Alloy Foundations, Alloy Lead, Etc.)</li> <li>Private health and dental care</li> </ul> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>Apply right here! You've found the application!</p> <p>Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p> <p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p> <p>For more information, please visit <a href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="d4b7d1c3-8ad6-4b6d-ab45-d3cb5a3aebe1">www.vml.com </a>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&e=" data-outlook-id="a3ef68bf-16fb-4ebc-9ca9-406007d6cefc">LinkedIn</a> #WeAreVML.</p></div><h3>Senior Consultant with experience in Commerce ecosystems and technologies wanted to join our Business Services team </h3> <h3>The opportunity:</h3> <p>How consumers discover, evaluate and buy products is changing faster than most organisations can respond. AI-powered search, agentic commerce, generative product discovery and the collapse of the traditional funnel are reshaping commercial models across every sector. Most enterprise clients know something has shifted, few have a clear plan for what to do about it.</p> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions is building a commerce consulting practice to help clients navigate these shifts. We work with some of the world's most recognised brands, translating complex commercial challenges into actionable strategies, transformation roadmaps and delivery programmes. What makes this role different from a boutique or a SaaS provider is what sits around you: your consulting recommendations connect directly to creative, content, CX and commerce execution teams who bring them to life. Strategy doesn't end at a slide deck here.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Consultant who can own projects and client relationships. Someone who takes an ambiguous brief, structures it independently, drives the strategic direction and ensures the quality of everything the team delivers. You'll lead client conversations, design and facilitate workshops, and be the person mid-to-senior client stakeholders trust to connect diagnostic findings to commercial action. You'll also play a key role in growing the practice, spotting extension opportunities within accounts, contributing to pitches and coaching more junior members of the team.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Perm </strong></li> <li><strong>London/Hybrid </strong></li> <li><strong>Travel to client site where required</strong></li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll be doing:</h3> <p><strong>Project Leadership & Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own medium-scale projects end-to-end: scope, quality, delivery timeline, and client relationship. Accountable for the strategic direction and the standard of output.</li> <li>Lead the development of strategic recommendations across commerce transformation, AI discoverability (GEO/AEO), agentic commerce readiness, content strategy and channel optimisation - shaping the narrative, not just building the analysis.</li> <li>Take ambiguous or loosely defined briefs and structure them into clear project plans with defined deliverables, milestones and resource requirements.</li> <li>Build and codify delivery methodologies into repeatable, scalable frameworks the wider team can execute against.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and lead workshops, stakeholder interviews and co-creation sessions. You will be comfortable going off-script when the conversation requires it and steering senior client stakeholders toward actionable outcomes.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to mid-to-senior client contacts. You are the person they call when they need the thinking sharpened or the direction challenged.<br>Anticipate and respond to client questions in a compelling and informed way. Own the client relationship day-to-day, identifying when senior escalation or support is needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts - spot the extension, the adjacent brief, the unasked question and work with senior leadership to convert them.</li> <li>Contribute meaningfully to proposals and pitch responses: shaping the strategic approach, writing key sections, and presenting to prospective clients where appropriate.</li> <li>Build client relationships that generate repeat work - not just deliver well, but leave clients wanting more.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team & Practice Building:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and develop Consultants on the team: Setting the quality bar on projects, giving direct feedback, and creating opportunities for junior team members to stretch.</li> <li>This role may line-manage 1–2 team members, depending on team structure.</li> <li>Drive practice IP development: reusable frameworks, case studies, proposition collateral and points of view that strengthen our market position and make selling easier.</li> <li>Work across WPP's integrated network: connecting upstream consulting recommendations to downstream execution in content, CX and commerce.</li> </ul> <h3>What we want from you:</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive professional experience, with a strong track record in consulting, strategy or senior commercial/digital roles (ideally blending both)</li> <li>Deep understanding of how commerce ecosystems work: You've either run a commerce operation (brand-side) or advised on one (agency/consulting-side). You understand how trading, content, category management, channel strategy and technology intersect in practice.</li> <li>Working knowledge of AI discoverability: GEO, AEO, LLM-influenced discovery, AI assistants and conversational commerce. You can advise a Head of Digital or VP of eCommerce on what this shift means for their business and back it up with a credible action plan.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead projects independently - you've managed scope, quality and client expectations without someone looking over your shoulder.</li> <li>Strong strategic and analytical thinking: you can take a diagnostic output or a data-heavy assessment and turn it into a clear, commercially prioritised set of recommendations with a compelling narrative.</li> <li>Excellent communication and executive presence - you're comfortable leading a room, running a workshop, and navigating a difficult client conversation with credibility.</li> <li>Experience building methodology or practice IP: You've created frameworks, playbooks or delivery approaches that others have adopted and scaled.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ideally you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Brand-side experience in eCommerce, digital marketing or commercial leadership - you've lived the reality of managing a P&L, running a digital operation, or leading a commerce team. This perspective is what separates a genuine consultant from a presenter of slides.</li> <li>Experience in at least two of: CPG/FMCG, Consumer health, Automotive, Retail, Telecom.</li> <li>Change management or enablement experience: you've helped organisations adopt new operating models, not just designed them.</li> <li>Line management or mentoring experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you know some of this, even better:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on curiosity with AI tools LLMs, agentic platforms, or similar.</li> <li>Experience with commerce technology (Shopify, SFCC, Commercetools, PIM/DAM systems).</li> </ul> <h3>What we can offer you:</h3> <ul> <li>The chance to shape a growing consulting practice your work will define methodology and propositions, not just execute someone else's.</li> <li>Direct access to iconic enterprise clients and the opportunity to contribute to both proposition development and project delivery.</li> <li>An integrated agency network where your consulting work connects to creative, content, CX and commerce teams who make the recommendations real.</li> <li>A team culture that values intellectual honesty, pace and ownership.</li> <li>London-based with flexible hybrid working and occasional client travel.</li> <li>Training, development, and a clear path to Senior Consultant and beyond.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Permanent only</strong><br>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.</p> <p>We lead with <strong>Heart</strong>, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.<br>We empower your <strong>Brains </strong>for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.<br>And we champion <strong>Courage</strong>, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.</p> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">At  WPP</span><span businesses rely on. around us. The kind of things we do regularly include working with not-for-profits to transform how they leverage technology, working with public bodies to shape digital services and working with top tier private entities to bring genuinely new and meaningful products and services to market. </p> <p><strong>Great Benefits</strong> – all the usual suspects and then some. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions Senior Robotics Software Engineer About Applied Intuition Defence Applied Intuition UK is a software and infrastructure supplier that accelerates the deployment of next-generation autonomous capabilities to the warfighter across air, land, sea, and space. A subsidiary of Applied Intuition, we deliver dual-use solutions to national security customers that build upon several years of product development and experience from commercial autonomy programs. Based in London, our seasoned defence team hails from Palantir, Anduril, SpaceX, Google, Lockheed Martin, and the UK and US Armed Services. Learn more at appliedintuitiondefense.com . About the role As a Robot Software Engineer, your day-to-day life will vary. Some days you might find yourself out in the field, integrating hardware and software directly onto vehicle platforms and pushing autonomy algorithms through live testing. Other days you'll be back in the office, deep in SIL and HIL environments, working through the complex autonomy and vehicle intelligence systems that span both hardware and software domains. And some days you'll be on-site with a customer, demoing what you built and troubleshooting in real time as they put it to the test. Every day is different, and each one moves the work forward. As a senior member of the team, you'll also help shape how the team tackles these problems, setting technical direction, raising the bar on integration practices, and mentoring engineers as they grow into the role. Along the way, you'll touch whatever it takes to make the platform work, such as mission behaviours development, platform integration, navigation, and everything in between. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable autonomy solutions for defense customers, drawing on computer networking, code integration, and a genuine passion for robotics. You'll build, test, and deploy your software, and then watch it actually fly. At Applied Intuition you will: Lead the technical design and architecture of autonomy solutions across one or more platforms, making key trade-off decisions independently Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers, reviewing designs and code to maintain high engineering standards Develop and adapt mission behaviour, navigation, and decision-making logic to meet the needs of diverse defense platforms and missions Design and implement autonomy capabilities that are modular and reusable across different vehicle types and programs Integrate and deploy autonomy solutions onto embedded Linux and other hardware platforms, including interfacing with sensors and collecting data Conduct system-level setup, testing, and validation, including software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluations Support live flight test of autonomy software on Group 1-5 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) Troubleshoot complex software and integration issues to ensure high reliability and performance across the stack Collaborate with 3rd party UAS vendors and cross-functional teams to bring autonomy software to life on OEM and Applied hardware alike Who we’re looking for: BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science, or related engineering field 6+ years of hands-on experience working with robotic systems (hardware, software, and integration) Demonstrated experience leading technical design decisions on complex, ambiguous autonomy problems with minimal guidance Experience developing autonomy behavior and decision-making logic (e.g., behavior trees, state machines) and/or navigation algorithms for robotic or autonomous systems Experience with modern C++ Experience integrating autonomy/robotics products with Pixhawk autopilots (ArduPilot and/or description: Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward. Role overview: We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you. As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team. Role requirements: UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates. Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place. People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit. Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint. Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently. Compensation Expertise : You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions. Performance Management : You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles. Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees. Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk. You could be a great fit if: 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions. ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence Bonus points if you have: An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification This role may not be a fit if: You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments. title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being its first Support Engineer across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process. Not sure which Support role is right for you? We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As Ashby’s first Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. What you’ll own Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved. Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be the first technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. You should not apply if: You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership. Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting. You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself. You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes. You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions. You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works. About Ashby Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com . About Go To Market We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. The ultimate objective is the realization of ultra-low-power, high-density cryogenic control ICs tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computing scale-out. Position Title: Senior Digital Designer (Front-End & Back-End) Domain Focus: Ultra-Low-Power Cryogenic CMOS (Cryo-CMOS) Digital Control Sub-circuits Design Scope: Full Lifecycle (RTL Development, AMS Co-Simulation, Physical Implementation, Low-Power Synthesis, and Tape-Out Signoff) Core Chip Architecture Target: Cryogenic digital logic blocks operating at sub-Kelvin regimes (<4.2 K), Experience - Essentials Education: Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline. Chip Design Experience: 5+ years of hands-on digital and mixed-signal IC design, demonstrating successful completion of at least 2 tape-outs on advanced semiconductor nodes Hardware Coding: Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for synthesizable RTL development and Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog-Real-Math for mixed-signal co-simulation and testbench environments. Design Tools: Proven proficiency with industry-standard EDA toolchains (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus/Xcelium, Synopsys Design Compiler) for mixed-signal simulation, synthesis, and verification. Physical Layout: Demonstrated capability in transforming RTL into GDSII/OASIS physical layouts, floorplanning, power grid synthesis, clock tree synthesis (CTS), multi-corner multi-mode static timing analysis (MCMM STA), and physical signoff (DRC/LVS/ERC). Communication & Logic Design: Experience architecting high-speed serial interconnect protocols (e.g., custom SPI, AXI, SerDes) and complex finite-state machine (FSM) control logic. Low Power & Thermal Management: Deep expertise in low-power dissipation techniques (clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling) within stringent thermal lift budgets of cryogenic cooling systems. Experience - Desirable Cryogenic CMOS Experience: Hands-on experience designing, modeling, or characterizing CMOS circuits at sub-4.2 K temperatures and understanding cryo-specific transistor behavior. Mixed-Signal & AMS Interfaces: Direct integration of digital logic with precision analog/RF front-ends (ADCs, DACs, LNAs, AWGs) for qubit control and readout. Quantum Architecture Awareness: Familiarity with quantum control interfaces, pulse generation, error correction, or cryogenic spin qubit electronics Low-Power Verification & UPF/CPF: Proficiency in power-aware simulation using IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF, formal LEC, and power signoff tools (Voltus, PrimePower). Advanced Process Nodes: Experience with sub-28nm nodes, with a strong preference for FD-SOI or FinFET technologies. EDA Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills (TCL, Python) to automate synthesis, physical design, and verification flows. DFT & Silicon Bring-Up: Practical knowledge of DFT insertion (Scan, MBIST) and post-silicon laboratory bring-up, testing, and debug. With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy. We are looking for a Data Product Manager to join our team in the UK. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, data and engineering, helping turn complex business needs into clear, actionable product direction. Your Mission As a Data Product Manager, you will own and evolve data-focused products, working closely with business stakeholders, Application Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Scientists. A key part of your role will be navigating complex business environments, understanding different stakeholder needs and turning complex requirements into a clear and prioritized product roadmap that can be delivered over the coming months. Partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Application Engineers. Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical dependencies and product objectives. Work with engineering teams to ensure requirements are clear, feasible and aligned with the overall product strategy. What We’re Looking For Proven experience as a Product Manager working with data products, BI/analytics products, data platforms or data infrastructure. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Nice to Have Experience with ML/AI model deployment or MLOps. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. title: 2027 Software Engineer Intern
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control (C2) missions. We create joint, time-sensitive, multi-domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our technology enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of endpoints across the globe. title: Software Quality Operations Specialist - Germany/Spain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>The Software Quality Operations (SWQOps) team is at the heart of enabling safe and successful scale-up into new international markets and incubating mission-critical, high-impact workflows. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.</p> <p><strong>Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success: </strong></p> <p>Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026, including international expansion to London and Tokyo) and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQOps, especially our Technical Specialists, plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. We are on the front lines of: </p> <ul> <li>International RO & New Market Readiness: Concerted effort to update triage policy, standing Voice of Customer in new countries. Through meticulous triage of driving events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQOps provides early warnings and critical insights to Product and Data Science partners.</li> <li>Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster international expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver.</li> <li>Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver. </li> <li>Workflow Incubation & Development: Incubating high-impact workflows and ensuring readiness for automation and long-term operational excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance. Provides technical requirements to Engineering for tooling that supports new market workflows (e.g., localization of ML/Gen-AI models, new data pipelines).</li> <li>Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs</li> <li>Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Define and document new policies, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that integrate AI tools and insights into daily vendor workflows.</li> <li>Design and implement robust quality control processes for both human and AI-generated outputs. Designs and validates new triage policies, SOPs, and quality control processes specifically for Continental European driving rules and data signals (Germany and Spain).</li> <li>Act as the Subject Matter Expert for technical policies and guidelines in the new market. Consult with local/international stakeholders to ensure seamless adoption of technical policies.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership and consultation to stakeholders to enhance our workflows and quality. You'll be at the forefront of identifying and escalating issues with our tools, providing technical requirements to engineering, and driving user testing to support the development and deployment of new tooling features.<br><br></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS/BA degree in a technical or analytical field, or 5+ years of relevant work experience in Autonomous Vehicles (AV), Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS), automotive systems engineering, robotics, or complex technical software operations.</li> <li>Active, valid driver's license with extensive personal on-road driving experience and a thorough understanding of driving rules, roadway design, and regulations in European metropolitan areas, specifically under the German (StVO) and/or Spanish (DGT) traffic frameworks.</li> <li>Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development lifecycle, from data preparation and training to validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics.</li> <li>Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts, analyze data logs using 3D visualization platforms, and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations.</li> <li>A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment and navigating technical ambiguity.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with a wide range of individuals in a diverse and dynamic work environment</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated strong execution with ability to drive outcomes in new environments, from early-stage to maturity  </li> <li>Strong communication skills in German </li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with international and/or offshore vendor teams to drive global process standardization and quality</li> <li>Analytic skills and basic SQL querying</li> <li>Competency in LLM / transformer models, and / or ML for robotics domain experience</li> <li>A greater focus on using your subject matter expertise for results analysis and direct customer consultation in the development of new and improved solutions</li> <li>Self-motivated with basic skills in task planning and time management</li> <li>Experience with project management or program management in a global, distributed environment</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. </span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£97,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£105,000 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enablement Lead
description: About Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we're growing fast. In-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one place: requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. More than 500 companies use Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage. We're backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others. The role We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it. You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues. This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us? What you'll do Own customer onboarding. Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it. Teach Legal AI fundamentals. Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology. Run live training. Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level. Build the self-paced academy. Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own. Maintain the enablement library. Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date. Re-enable struggling customers. Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency. Train the champions. Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account. Shape in-app help. Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself. Measure whether learning worked. Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach. Partner across customer teams. Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes. What we're looking for 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central. You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes. Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users. Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it. A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them. Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail. Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it. Curiosity about AI and legal technology. You don't need a legal background, but you'll want to learn the product and our customers' work deeply. A strong learning mindset: you welcome feedback, apply coaching and want to grow quickly. How we work We're an in-person team in Edinburgh, so expect to work from the office or visit customers by default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people real ownership. There won't always be a playbook, so you'll bring curiosity, structure and persistence. You'll work closely with the VP of Transformation and with Customer Success, Account Management and Product. Each customer team has a clear remit: Transformation leads implementation Support Engineering resolves technical issues Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability Why join Wordsmith Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding inside larger organisations. Because Legal AI is new to almost everyone who buys it, teaching it well is one of the highest-leverage things we can do. You'll join early enough to define what customer enablement at Wordsmith is: the curriculum, the certifications, and the standard for what a confident user looks like. You'll work directly with ambitious legal teams, learn the product deeply and develop fast in a high-performing team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Engagement Lead (Technology Advisory)
description: <p><strong>London, UK</strong></p> <p>Principal Engagement Leads at Thoughtworks are the delivery and solution leaders for AI-native advisory engagements. advisory assets.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Job qualifications</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Technical Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have 8–15 years of experience in consulting and strategy, with putting together proposals, pitch decks, RFIs, and RFQs.</li> <li>You are comfortable with new AI tooling, possessing the ability to design workflows around AI, evaluate the confidence of AI output, and continuously enhance your technical skills over time.</li> <li>You are an expert in systems thinking, allowing you to analyze how business processes, technology, data flows, and end-to-end dependencies fit together.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Professional Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You thrive in a collaborative, non-hierarchical environment that values transparency, openness, outcomes.</li> <li>You understand how to balance AI capabilities with human oversight, knowing how to apply human judgment to direct AI tools effectively and move past anodyne outputs.</li> </ul> title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You will report to our Senior Manager of Data & AI Products, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more! What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure. A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs. Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources. Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning. Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka. Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based). AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment. Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two. The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement. Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers. You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements. You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering. This role is not a good fit for you if: You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy. You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team. You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will: Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised. Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it. Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary. Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis. 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options. We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. title: [2028 graduates] Intern (Antitrust & Competition Economics Practice) - Summer 2027
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. For more than 50 years, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.</p> <p>CRA's <strong><a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a></strong> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.</p> <p>We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.</p> <p><em>We seek candidates for our London, UK location.</em></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Our <a href="https://www.crai.com/careers/intern-program/">Summer Analyst/Associate Internship program</a> mirrors the analyst experience to give you an understanding of our business and experience project work at Charles River Associates. Throughout the 8-10 week program, Analyst/Associate Interns work alongside senior colleagues to deliver live client consulting projects within the practice area. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development and wellness support programs, social events to connect you with peers and a collegial work environment. title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Platform

Our R&D organization is home to some of the most innovative minds in cloud infrastructure and open-source software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You get to go in at the ground level of how our production infrastructure is designed, built, tested and deployed. Your work will directly influence how we build Astro, Observe and our IDE product, as well as how global organizations orchestrate data pipelines at scale—making them faster, more reliable, and easier to manage. If you’re driven by impact, excited by scale, and ready to work on the kind of infrastructure challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud-native systems, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. What you get to do: Make high-quality, data-driven and experience-driven decisions on how we build this and the next generation of our production platform, then deliver the results. Own and build how we test, build and deploy code in a high-scale PaaS environment. Collaborate across the whole company on how we design production systems, set standards and make technology choices for new and existing products, and how these fit together. Deliver results - we routinely “change the wheels on the bus while it’s moving”, in a predictable, safe and reliable way. Be at the forefront of how we work together as a Platform Engineering team. Blaze a Trail : Work on a small but growing team on building out the Platform/Reliability practice for the company – this role reports directly to the VP of Reliability. Be an Owner : Be directly involved in decision-making on what we work on, as well as how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them. Do Sensible Things : Be directly involved in determining how our platform works. Participate in incident management and determine sensible practices as the platform evolves. Garage Door Open : Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation for systems and processes, ensuring clarity and accessibility. Strong proficiency in Python, Golang and in-depth experience with Kubernetes (CKA or equivalent or greater). Experience with observability principles and technologies, including SLI/SLO definition and tracking. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in working with a globally distributed team in delivery. A passion for reliability and operational excellence. A low tolerance for toil and other nonsense. Ability to estimate the scope of work accurately and coordinate with stakeholders to address risks and ensure successful project delivery. Experience with (and ideally strong opinions on) software development best practices, such as code review, testing, CI/CD, version control, automation and debugging. Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues, with a focus on ownership and accountability. Bonus points if you have: Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers. Experience with our particular tech stack components and technologies (deep breath): CircleCI, Chronosphere (Prometheus), Splunk, Bazel, Istio, Playwright, Karpenter, Github [Actions] … Experience of the innards and quirks of AWS, GCP and (particularly) Azure.
